questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations [6]. Tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI features synthesize answers from multiple sources and decide which brands to name [6]. GEO is broader and longer term than answer engine optimization (AEO), aiming to make a brand a recognized, trusted entity that AI systems mention by name [5].
